passives.name: ByakuyaEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
This unit deals +{1}% more damage to enemies with Movespeed-related $Modifiers.

When an enemy is inflicted with $HardCC, this unit will:
- $FollowUpAttack on that enemy with $Byakuya_Skill2 for {2}% of this unit's damage
(Local Cooldown: {3}s)

passives.name: ByakuyaEquipmentPassive2
passives.description:
When this unit attacks an enemy afflicted with $Dismember, gains:
- +{1}% Damage
- +{2}% Range
If $Dismember was applied by a $BleachCategory unit, instead gains:
- +{3}% Damage
- +{4}% Range
